func:
// The VRM portal id is the second segment of every Venus MQTT topic.
// Learning it means nothing has to be hardcoded per installation.
const id = String(msg.topic || '').split('/')[1]
if (!id || id === '+') return null
if (global.get('venusPortalId') === id) return null
global.set('venusPortalId', id)
node.status({ fill: 'green', shape: 'dot', text: id })
return [null, { payload: { lv: 'info', m: 'Venus portal id ' + id } }]

name: Read me first
info:
Every debug node on this tab is switched OFF.
Click the small square on the right of a node to enable it, and switch it off again once the flow works.

Order to work through when commissioning:
  1. Raw device read  - confirms BLE and pairing
  2. Normalised state - confirms the parser found your topics
  3. Outgoing command - confirms a button reaches the heater
  4. Errors           - the first place to look when nothing moves
  5. MQTT to Venus    - only when the GX Touch is out of step

v1.14: how this tab works
info:
Flow context is PER TAB. This tab keeps its own copy of the heater state (bridgeFull / bridgePending, written by "Publish to D-Bus mirror") because the Poller's `state` is not visible here. "GX Touch to command" compares every incoming /Settings/Truma/* value against that copy; only a value that differs from the heater AND from any in-flight write becomes a command. Without that comparison every mirror write would echo back as a command (endless BLE loop).

Settings paths are created at start by "Ensure Truma settings" (localsettings AddSetting via the Venus dbus CLI). The two temperature services the QML binds to are provided by venus/dbus-truma-temp, not by this flow.
